FeygardSerg_guild03_1.m:
(Gives you a surprised look). How ...?
Who are you kid?

FeygardSerg_guild03_10.m: Agh, thank you. You are valiant, kid. I hope to see you when we are both out of here. I'll invite you for a drink!
r: OK, thank you. Now I have to run.
Yeah, sounds good. For the glory of Feygard I'll avenge your mates!

FeygardSerg_guild03_2.m:
Wait! That's not actually important.
Leave this dangerous place, right now!
r: You are right. It would be better to leave.
Hah! No way, I won't give up.
I'm here because ... I'm here to help you!

FeygardSerg_guild03_3.m: My whole patrol is dead! Why do you think you have any chance of success?
r: I managed to reach this place. Is that not enough for you?
I'm not here to discuss that with you.

FeygardSerg_guild03_4a.m: It's your life, do whatever you want.
r: Please tell me what do you know about the current situation.

FeygardSerg_guild03_4b.m: Indeed, I don't know why are you here!

FeygardSerg_guild03_5.m: I don't know much. Only that me and my patrol were sent here to arrest a murderer. But what we found was unexpected.

FeygardSerg_guild03_6.m: We reached these passages via a forest cavern, and went through the beasts without any major problem. Suddenly, the suspect appeared with a group of men, probably his allies or subordinates ...

FeygardSerg_guild03_7.m: Those people were fast. Very fast and very dangerous. They killed them! My fellows, all of them defeated!

FeygardSerg_guild03_8.m: I managed to get rid of most of them, but I'm severely wounded and unable to continue ...

FeygardSerg_guild03_9a.m:
Don't you understand? You must leave this place before you can't.

He's playing with us!
r: You are right. I will leave.
Take these supplies and leave. I'll avenge your mates.
Don't worry. You must report this before it is too late. I'll go there instead of you.

FeygardSerg_guild03_9b.m: Kid, why are you still here? Leave me, I'm just resting a bit.
r: Don't be rude! I'm here to help you. Please leave and go to a safer place.
Calm down. Take these supplies and call backup!

FeygardSerg_guild03_dead.m:
You ... Argh ... 
[The sergeant takes one final breath and then dies. You should have come earlier. Now you will never get to know what he wanted to tell you.]

Thieves03.15: A Crossroads guard told me that Feygard has sent more soldiers to the south, to try and find the criminals' hideout.
Thieves03.20: The barricade guard has a big mouth, and told me all I needed to know. The hideout is near a place full of larval burrowers. I need to move faster than the patrols to reach the hideout before them.
Thieves03.21: I found a small hole which seems to lead to a cave. Crackshot and his henchmen are probably hiding there.
Thieves03.22: I reached the hideout and saw some recent blood stains. Maybe there was a fight there.
Thieves03.24: I heard screams and sword clashes nearby. I should take a look.
Thieves03.25: There was a massacre. The Feygard patrol reached this place, but they seem to have all been killed. I must continue.

Thieves03.36: I tried to open the door behind Crackshot, but for some reason I cannot get the key into the lock.
Thieves03.40: The dying Crackshot said something about the key. If he told the truth, it could be cursed.

Thieves03.50: Finally, this job is done. Now I should take a rest and regain my strength.
